summary: Amprius Technologies filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing entry on September 23, 2026 into an Other Transaction Agreement with the United States for Project acCELLerate, awarded under 10 U.S.C. 4022. The fixed-price award totals up to $75 million, with no company cost share, and roughly $22 million obligated from FY2025 RDT&E funds for a base period running September 23, 2026 through September 22, 2028. Payments occur on accepted milestones. This is a government contract, not a special situation; watch milestone execution and termination-for-convenience risk.
